SELECT VARCHAR(TABSCHEMA, 10) AS TABSCHEMA, VARCHAR(TABNAME, 24) AS TABNAME, VARCHAR(COLNAME, 10) AS COLNAME FROM SYSCAT.COLUMNS WHERE COLNAME IN ('HIGH2KEY', 'LOW2KEY') ORDER BY 1, 2, 3
